interconnection_url.notes: PG&E's own utility-wide Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025 and remains an active program per SGIP's own statewide announcements (most recently dated 2026-07-23). Administered across PG&E's entire distribution territory, which includes Shafter/Kern County.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Reused as a utility-level fact already established for other IOU-territory records this session: the CPUC-administered SGIP program applies uniformly across the named utility's entire distribution territory, directly verified via SGIP's own site (selfgenca.com) / the CPUC's own SGIP program page, including a program-status announcement as recent as 2026-07-23 confirming the program remains active.

value.name: SB 379 Residential Solar Permit Application (submitted online at forms.shafter.com/Forms/ResidentialSolar)

value: Request inspections by emailing buildinginspection@shafterca.gov, or via the online Commercial Inspection Request Form for commercial projects
inspection_steps.notes: The City's own Building Permits page names this as the inspection-request contact, but does not itemize a fuller scheduling process (lead time, hours, confirmation) beyond the email address.

value.notes: The City's own Building Permits page states, for its online residential permit applications (which explicitly list Solar as an eligible category): 'Every effort will be made to respond the same day if your application is received early in the day. Please allow one to five business days for processing.'

other_conditions: The city separately publishes a 'Solar Signage, Fire, and Code Requirements' document covering PV signage and fire-safety compliance.
